notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention: bank 'b' is rows f-j, which is the upper half of the breadboard in the image (rows labelled j..f).

Resistor is read from the image as spanning columns 3 and 6 in row h. The LED anode (longer, bent leg) is in 6i and the cathode is in 8i. The orange wire from pin 9 ends at 3g, and the black wire from the GND header pin ends at 8h.
The Uno's GND pin next to AREF is mapped to GND.1.
The manual specifies a 220 ohm resistor in series with the LED, with the anode on the resistor side and the cathode to ground.
The wire colours come from the image. The schematic and circuit image agree.
